name: pass-the-specs
description: Fast, guided device testing for the shop floor.
author: Pass the Specs

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n ui,app -c red,gray "vite" "wait-on tcp:5173 && cross-env PTS_DEV=1 electron ."
scripts.dist: npm run build:ui && electron-builder --win portable --publish never
scripts.dist:folder: npm run build:ui && electron-builder --win dir --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build:ui && electron-builder --mac zip --universal --publish never

extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: Pass the Specs uses the camera to test it works.
extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Pass the Specs uses the microphone to test it works.
